description: An Aggressive Raider is a ruthless marauder, often found leading raids on unsuspecting villages or caravans. They are brutal and efficient in combat, driven by greed and a thirst for bloodshed. With a muscular frame and scarred skin, these raiders are feared by travelers and small communities alike.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the Aggressive Raider can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The Aggressive Raider has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the raider's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Aggressive Raider makes two melee attacks with its greataxe.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12 + 4 slashing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 2 piercing damage.
